scripts.test: bun run --filter @jakobgruen/happy-wire test && bun run --filter happy-coder test && bun run --filter happy-server test
scripts.eas:preview: mise use ruby@3.3 && cd packages/happy-app && eas build --platform ios --profile preview --local --non-interactive --output ./preview.ipa
scripts.eas:testflight: mise use ruby@3.3 && cd packages/happy-app && eas build --platform ios --profile testflight --local --non-interactive --output ./testflight.ipa && eas submit --platform ios --path ./testflight.ipa
scripts.eas:dev: mise use ruby@3.3 && cd packages/happy-app && eas build --platform ios --profile development --local --non-interactive --output ./dev.ipa
scripts.eas:preview:cloud: cd packages/happy-app && eas build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.eas:testflight:cloud: cd packages/happy-app && eas build --platform ios --profile testflight
